reason: سْمِ is governed by the prefixed بِ in the formula بِسْمِ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayhi of سْمِ.
ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ follows ٱللَّهِ in genitive definiteness as an adjectival divine epithet.
ٱلرَّحِيمِ follows ٱللَّهِ in the same genitive adjectival series.
إِذَا sets the temporal condition for جَآءَ.
نَصْرُ is nominative and is the explicit subject of جَآءَ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayh of نَصْرُ.
ٱلْفَتْحُ is coordinated by وَ with نَصْرُ as the second element in the subject.
ٱلنَّاسَ is accusative as the direct object of رَأَيْتَ.
يَدْخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا is the ḥāl clause describing ٱلنَّاسَ after رَأَيْتَ.
دِينِ is governed by فِي as the prepositional complement of يَدْخُلُونَ.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive muḍāf ilayh of دِينِ.
أَفْوَاجًا is an accusative ḥāl describing the manner of يَدْخُلُونَ.
حَمْدِ is governed by prefixed بِـ as the complement of سَبِّحْ.
رَبِّكَ is the genitive muḍāf ilayh of حَمْدِ.
The suffix كَ in رَبِّكَ is the possessive muḍāf ilayh of رَبِّ.
ٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ is coordinated by وَ with the imperative سَبِّحْ.
The suffix هُ in ٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ is the object pronoun of ٱسْتَغْفِرْ.
The suffix هُ in إِنَّهُ is the ism governed by إِنَّ.
كَانَ تَوَّابًا is the khabar of إِنَّ in إِنَّهُ.
تَوَّابًا is the accusative predicate of كَانَ.
